summary.text: John Shirts is a Republican who represents District 9 (Seat A) in the Idaho House of Representatives and is listed in a first term; the directory lists Shirts as an attorney and U.S. Air Force Reserve JAG officer.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's biography, Shirts was raised on Shirts's family's ranch in Washington County, attended Weiser High School, and earned a B.S. from the University of Idaho and a J.D. from the University of Colorado Law School.
It says Shirts served as a U.S. Air Force JAG officer, including in Korea, was appointed an Assistant United States Attorney, and now serves as a prosecutor in the Air Force Reserve.
